newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads Pakistani for murder.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads Pakistani for murder.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Wednesday beheaded a Pakistani man for killing an Indian national, Saudi state television reported.
An Interior Ministry statement carried on televison said the convicted man assaulted the Indian with a metal pipe at a farm and stole his money.
He was the 29th person executed this year in the conservative kingdom that strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by beheading convicted murders, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
